page_title: REN 1-0 TOU | Rennes v Toulouse 28/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+2' A header by Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) from very close range goes towards the crossbar, but doesn't get past Brice Samba, who makes a brilliant save.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Arnaud Nordin will be replaced by Nordan Mukiele (Rennes).
88' The current number of corner kicks is 6:1.
84' Djibril Sidibe pings in the corner towards the centre of the box and finds Emersonn (Toulouse) unmarked, but his free header is woeful and slips well over the bar.
84' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) takes the corner.
84' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Toulouse will have a corner.
81' Franck Haise has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Breel Embolo (Rennes) replacing Esteban Lepaul.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jacen Russell-Rowe (Toulouse) replaces Warren Kamanzi.
80' Chance! Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Ludovic Blas, but his shot from inside the box flashes just over the bar.
78' Pape Demba (Toulouse) fails to deliver a decent cross from a long-range free kick. The opposition's defence intercepts the effort.
77' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
76' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
75' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
74' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) latches onto a rebound and hits a long-range effort that flies well wide of the right post.
74' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Alexis Vossah walks off the pitch to be replaced by Mario Sauer (Toulouse).
74' A cross from the free kick is whipped in by Ludovic Blas (Rennes), but one of the defenders steps in and averts the threat.
73' Here is a change. Mousa Tamari is going off and Franck Haise gives the last tactical orders to Ludovic Blas (Rennes).
73' The referee allows time for a substitution. Sebastian Szymanski will be replaced by Djaoui Cisse (Rennes).
71' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) sprays a pass out to Dayann Methalie, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
71' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) sends a long ball in, but Guillaume Restes comfortably gathers the ball.
69' 8:5 – the total goal attempt statistics. Shots on target – 2:1.
67' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
67' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts. Good work from Rennes as they win a corner.
66' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Rennes will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
65' The resulting corner, taken by Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes), comes to nothing.

65' That's unlucky! Mousa Tamari (Rennes) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared. The referee signals a corner kick to Rennes.
65' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes).
64' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Now Rennes have a corner.
64' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.

63' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Alexis Vossah (Toulouse) was quite harsh and Stephanie Frappart didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
57' Emersonn (Toulouse) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Brice Samba sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner.
56' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) hits a first-time volley towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort is way off target and the ball goes well wide of the right post.
56' Pape Demba (Toulouse) picks out Emersonn with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
54' The ball is cleared after Quentin Merlin (Rennes) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
50' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) brings an opponent down and Stephanie Frappart interrupts the game.
49' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball goes out of play and Rennes will have a goal kick.

47' Djibril Sidibe sprays a wonderful pass out to Emersonn (Toulouse), who cannot get enough power or direction to cause Brice Samba problems and the goalkeeper is able to watch the ball go just wide of the right post.
46' Carles Martinez makes a half-time substitution. Emersonn comes on in place of Julian Vignolo (Toulouse).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' The referee is firm and issues Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) a deserved yellow card.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
42' Pape Demba (Toulouse) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
42' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) volleys the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but one of the defenders blocks his shot.
40' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Rennes.
39' A sweet pass inside the box gives Mahdi Camara (Rennes) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
38' The Rennes players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
36' Mahdi Camara (Rennes) tries to find Arnaud Nordin, but he puts too much power on the pass. It's a throw-in for Toulouse.
36' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
31' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) cracks a splendid volley from just outside the box that brushes the left post. It was an incredible shot and the goalkeeper was really lucky not to concede a goal.
31' Total attempts – 5:1. The shots on goal statistics – 2:0.
29' Warren Kamanzi (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box, but Brice Samba comes off his line to gather the ball.
27' 1 - 0 Arnaud Nordin (Rennes) is quickest to the rebound inside the penalty area, and he plants a header directly into the top right corner.
24' Esteban Lepaul (Rennes) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.
22' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.

22' Quentin Merlin (Rennes) fires in a promising strike from the free kick just outside the penalty area. His nice effort flies towards the bottom left corner but is denied by Guillaume Restes, who pulls off a glorious save!
21' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Stephanie Frappart blows his whistle for a foul. Toulouse have a free kick from a promising distance.

19' Warren Kamanzi almost found himself in a promising position after Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
18' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
17' The ball possession at the moment is 76:24.
16' The game is interrupted now, Mousa Tamari (Rennes) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
16' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
16' The free kick is taken by Pape Demba (Toulouse), but ball is cleared.
15' Mahamadou Nagida (Rennes) commits an ugly tackle on his opponent, but there is no caution from the referee. Toulouse will take a free kick near the side line.

13' Chance! Arnaud Nordin sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Esteban Lepaul (Rennes), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker over the bar.
12' Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stephanie Frappart signals. Free kick. Rennes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
12' Dayann Methalie (Toulouse) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
10' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) is in a clear offside position and the referee blows his whistle after the linesman raises his flag.
8' Mousa Tamari (Rennes) attempts to find Mahdi Camara with a delicate little through ball from inside the box, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
5' It looks like Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) saw red with that tackle. Stephanie Frappart won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
4' Santiago Hidalgo (Toulouse) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Brice Samba, who smothers the ball.
4' Sebastian Szymanski (Rennes) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
3' The Rennes players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The ball rebounded to Quentin Merlin (Rennes), whose first-time shot from long range had the keeper scrambling but flew just wide of the left post.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Rennes will kick the game off.
Stephanie Frappart is introduced as the referee for today's match.
